description: This file defines a Flutter widget for the Settings screen in a mobile expense tracker app. It contains UI elements allowing navigation to link a bank account, theme selection, and displays a site URL loaded from environment variables.

classes.name: SettingsScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the Settings screen with options for linking bank accounts, theme settings, and displaying a site URL.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the Settings screen, including an app bar and a list of setting options.
